title: A Crh-defined insular cortex–brainstem–thalamic circuit regulates anxiety-related behavioral states
title_zh: 定义了一个以Crh为特征的岛叶-脑干-丘脑电路，调节与焦虑相关的行为状态
abstract: Anxiety disorders are among the most prevalent and debilitating psychiatric conditions, yet the neural circuits underlying anxiety-related states remain incompletely understood. Here we identify a cortical–brainstem–thalamic pathway in which Crh-expressing neurons in the anterior and middle insular cortex (a/mIC) engage the parabrachial nucleus (PBN), which in turn recruits the posterior paraventricular thalamic nucleus (pPVT) to contribute to anxiety-related behavior. Single-cell calcium imaging reveals that the predator odorant 2-methyl-2-thiazoline (2-MT) and footshock recruit partially overlapping populations of PBN-projecting a/mIC neurons; neurons activated by both stimuli exhibit increased activity during open-arm approach in the elevated plus maze. Exposure to 2-MT increases corticotropin-releasing factor (CRF) signals in the PBN, where CRF enhances PBN neuronal excitability and CRF receptor 1 (CRFR1) signaling facilitates a/mIC-terminal-evoked firing. Inhibition of Crh⁺ a/mIC–PBN projections, Crh knockdown in the a/mIC, or blockade of CRFR1 signaling within the PBN attenuates 2-MT-induced anxiety-like behavior. Human neuroimaging further reveals stronger functional coupling within a putative homologous aIC–PBN–pPVT network in individuals with anxiety symptoms, and the strength of this coupling correlates with anxiety severity. Together, these findings define a molecularly specified insular circuit that contributes to anxiety-related behavioral states.
abstract_zh: 焦虑症是最常见且最致残的精神疾病之一，但潜在其焦虑相关状态的神经电路仍然知之甚少。本研究确定了一条皮质-脑干-丘脑通路，其中前部和中部岛叶（a/mIC）的Crh表达神经元激活桥脑核（PBN），进而招募后丘下丘外侧核（pPVT）以参与焦虑相关行为。单细胞钙成像显示，气味诱导剂2-甲基-2-噻唑啉（2-MT）和足电击招募了部分重叠的PBN投射a/mIC神经元；由两种刺激激活的神经元在开放臂探索升高迷宫中表现出活动增加。接触2-MT会在PBN中增加皮质激素释放因子（CRF）信号，其中CRF增强PBN神经元兴奋性，CRF受体1（CRFR1）信号促进a/mIC末梢诱导的放电。抑制Crh⁺ a/mIC–PBN投射、在a/mIC中敲低Crh，或在PBN中阻断CRFR1信号，均能减轻2-MT诱导的焦虑样行为。人类功能成像进一步揭示，在焦虑症状个体中，假设同源的aIC–PBN–pPVT网络内功能连接更强，且这种连接强度与焦虑严重程度相关。总之，这些发现定义了一种分子规范的岛叶电路，有助于焦虑相关行为状态。
